question: Reply barrage against phasing infantry in a level-two fortification: how much does the terrain shift matter?

y.label: % of barrages that pin or destroy

finding: Against phasing infantry in a level-two fortification (shifted 2 bands under option 1), the reply barrage pins or destroys up to 39 percentage points more often under option 2, at 3-4 points (39 % against 0 %). Expected strength destroyed per barrage is up to 0.44 TOE points higher under option 2 (at 13-14 points).
